posts.html:
Product design for a budgeting app used by 40,000 households.

The challenge

The client needed something that felt considered without feeling expensive, and they needed it in six weeks.

The approach

We started with three directions on paper, chose one in a single meeting, and spent the rest of the time on details.

  • Research and interviews
  • Identity and interface design
  • Hand-off with documented components
The best design decisions are the ones you never have to explain.

Landing page and brand for a focus-timer app.

The challenge

The client needed something that felt considered without feeling expensive, and they needed it in six weeks.

The approach

We started with three directions on paper, chose one in a single meeting, and spent the rest of the time on details.

  • Research and interviews
  • Identity and interface design
  • Hand-off with documented components
The best design decisions are the ones you never have to explain.
